keyFindings.description: Main's #2362 brings an optional stream byte limit (ENVOY_STREAM_MAX_BYTES) with a clustered stream; a full clustered stream keeps a refused message's id at sequence 0, so every later publish under that id is acknowledged {seq:0, duplicate:true} for the 72 h duplicate window. The merge ports main's resend-without-MsgId to PublishAsync only; the outbox's role forward goes through window.Request with a MsgId, and for a holder with a serving port (AcceptStreamAck) answers() requires Sequence > 0, so each retry times out as ErrNotAcknowledged, the (owner, holder) chain is held, and the event stalls up to 72 h after the stream has room. Reproduced by DeepReview9 on the in-process 3-server cluster (16 KiB limit, fill, purge, three retries all not acknowledged, nothing stored; control nil). Main's listener forward had no MsgId and recovered at once. Fix: in window.request with AcceptStreamAck, a sequence-0 duplicate reply resends once without the MsgId header under the same deadline and connection checks; test as the repro.
